255985654_17e1883b.text: The gain of retinogeniculate signal transmission is modulated by nonretinal inputs to dLGN. These nonretinal inputs arise from visual cortex, pretectum, brainstem, thalamic reticular nuclei, and local dLGN interneurons, and they far outnumber the more powerful retinal inputs (Sherman et al., 2002)(Sherman, 2004)

255985654_a88750af.text: .One set of nerve terminals contain flattened, oval shaped synaptic vesicles, a hallmark feature of inhibitory GABAergic terminals, and are therefore called F terminals (Sherman, 2004)(Lund et al., 1972)(Famiglietti, 1970). In dLGN, GABAergic terminals arise from the thalamic reticular nucleus and local inhibitory interneurons [7,18]19].
